messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Yeah, hi, I need to cancel my mother's appointment. Irene Kowalski.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help cancel your mother's appointment. To get started, I need to verify her identity. What's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942.
AGENT: Thank you. And just to confirm, what's your name?
CALLER: Walt Kowalski, I'm her son. I'm on her account, been handling her appointments for a while now.
AGENT: Got it, Walt. Let me pull up Irene's appointments so we can see which one you'd like to cancel. Perfect, Walt. You're all set as an authorized contact. Let me get her upcoming appointments. Irene has two upcoming appointments. One is with Dr. Thomas Hughes on Tuesday, October 6th at ten in the morning, and the other is with Dr. Helen Brandt on Thursday, October 8th at two in the afternoon. Which one would you like to cancel?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_appointments]
CALLER: The one with the memory doctor, Brandt. She still needs the Hughes one.
AGENT (LATEST): Got it, I'll cancel the appointment with Dr. Brandt on October 8th at two in the afternoon. All set, Walt. The appointment with Dr. Brandt on Thursday, October 8th has been cancelled. Irene's appointment with Dr. Hughes on Tuesday, October 6th is still on the books.  [system actions: cancel_appointment]

CONDITIONS:
move_1: the agent asks to speak to Irene or asks for proof of guardianship
stop_0: Agent confirms the Brandt appointment is cancelled and the Hughes one is still on.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask to speak to Irene or for guardianship proof"}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed Brandt cancelled and Hughes still scheduled"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of hanging up or calling 911"}}
